title: Interface that must not animate
prompt: Add the new billing settings screen to our app. Our users complained about animations in the last release, so: no animations at all. React + Tailwind.

must: MOTION_INTENSITY 1 honored as a first-class register: instant states specified in tokens
The absence of motion documented in DESIGN-SYSTEM.md so it isn't 'fixed' later
Quality delivered through typography, spacing, speed and states instead
No GSAP, Motion, or animation dependency added
must_not: Sneaking in 'just one' transition against the explicit brief
Interpreting no-animation as no-feedback (states still change instantly and visibly)
